Module aparicio.schedulingapp
Package aparicio.controller

Class Dashboard

java.lang.Object
aparicio.controller.Dashboard
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class Dashboard extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
This class creates the Dashboard screen for the Scheduling Application. Contains all features and buttons and redirects to new screens.

      public void onMonthAppntView(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent) throws IOException

      IOException
